1.explanation: This minimal React example mounts a Carbon ComboBox in which you can test Chinese IME composition. Install the same Carbon versions as in the bug report (carbon-components-react@7.9.0), run the app, focus the input, switch to a Zhuyin IME, and type “5j/ jp6hk4g4”. You will observe that ComboBox shows the raw Zhuyin symbols instead of waiting for the compositionend event to convert them into Chinese characters, reproducing the bug illustrated in the provided screenshots.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a Carbon ComboBox with default filtering behavior and try to input Chinese via a Zhuyin IME (for example, type the keystrokes “5j/ jp6hk4g4” to compose “中文測試”), the text field immediately shows the raw Zhuyin symbols (e.g. ㄓㄨㄥ ㄨㄣˊㄘㄜˋㄕˋ) instead of letting you finish composition and select the actual Chinese characters. In other words, the IME composition is broken and the component filters prematurely on each key stroke rather than waiting for the composition end event.
